pages.text: The $(thing)Beneath$() is a network of very deep caves, directly below the Overworld.$(br)This dimension is balanced around mid to late $(thing)Metallurgy Age$().$(br2)It's more dangerous than the surface, so we recommend a metal shield and good nutrition as a minimum, but some armor, a water flask, cooling clothes, and a ranged weapon will help a lot.

It differs from the usual Nether experience in a few ways:$(li)You enter it $(l:beneath/beneath#entering)differently$()$(li)Water doesn't instantly evaporate$(li)A bed works like normal$(li)Traveling Beneath is no faster than in the Overworld$(br2)In return, you can find resources like $(thing)Kaolin Clay$(), $(thing)Graphite$(), richer and more exposed $(thing)ore veins$(), as well as other treasures.

$(li)$(bold)$(l:beneath/beneath#entering)Entering$() and $(bold)$(l:beneath/beneath#exiting)Exiting$()$(li)$(bold)$(l:beneath/beneath#biomes)Biomes$()$(li2)$(l:beneath/beneath#salt_caves)Top Layer$()$(li2)$(l:beneath/beneath#tar_pools)Middle Layer$()$(li2)$(l:beneath/beneath#ash_forest)Bottom Layer$()$(li)$(bold)$(l:beneath/beneath#geology)Geology$()$(li2)$(l:beneath/beneath#more_rocks)More Rocks$()
Tak nie rób!

pages.title: Wejście do Głębin
pages.text: To travel Beneath, simply find some overworld Bedrock at $(thing)Y=-58$().$(br2)To get down to the bedrock, you'll have to either break through the Hornfels layer with $(l:game_mechanics/mining#explosives)Explosives$() or $(item)Steel+ Tools$(), find a cave with the more brittle $(thing)Keratophyre$(), or drain a lava lake.$(br2)Note that $(item)Primitive Explosives$() are not strong enough to break Hornfels.

You will appear in the Beneath at the same X and Z coordinates, with a 3x2x3 space opened for you to place some supports if necessary.$(br2)A temporary cloud will be provided if there is no floor, as well as short $(thing)Slow Falling$() and $(thing)Fire Protection$() effects to prevent any accidents.

pages.title: Wyjście z Głębin
pages.text: To return, just get up to ceiling bedrock in the same fashion.$(br2)It's a good idea to $(thing)make a note$() of where you entered, so you can return to the same place in the overworld whenever you're ready to leave.

You will be returned at $(thing)Y=-54$(), above any potential lava lakes, inside another 3x2x3 area. The middle two blocks for the player will always be replaced by air, so you may want to avoid placing ladders there.

pages.title: Biomy
pages.text: The Beneath has a full set of new biomes to explore!$(br2)The Beneath can be split into three vertical layers, each with their own set of biomes. Each one is more hot and dangerous as you descend!

pages.title: Jaskinie solne
pages.text: Jak ciepła oceaniczna bryza, ten biom jest pełen $(item)halitu$(). Świetne miejsce na bazę!

pages.title: Duszne bagno
pages.text: Wilgotny i bagienny. Bezpieczne źródło drewna, jeśli umiesz unikać $(thing)krokodyli$().

pages.title: Rozpadające się jaskinie
pages.text: W tym wilgotnym regionie pełnym zgnilizny natura ciężko pracuje nad rozkładem.

pages.title: Leże pająków
pages.text: Brak nagród za odgadnięcie co tu żyje! Świetne miejsce do zbierania $(item)jedwabiu$().

pages.title: Doły ze smołą
pages.text: Piaszczysty jak mała pustynia, ten obszar zawiera lepkie $(thing)doły ze smołą$() pełne oleju.

pages.title: Źródła geotermalne
pages.text: Nie ma tu siarkowych kostek, ale w tym parnym biomie można znaleźć $(thing)wodę źródlaną$(), która przydaje się do leczenia.

pages.title: Cierniowy gaj
pages.text: Trudny do podróżowania biom z roślinami, które ranią cię po nadepnięciu. Uważaj!

pages.title: Bujna jaskinia
pages.text: Gorąco i pełno zieleni! Gęste paprocie skrywają leżącą pod nimi $(thing)glinę kaolinową$().

pages.title: Popiołowy las
pages.text: To, co pozostaje z zieleni po częstych pożarach wywołanych przez upał.

pages.title: Potoki lawy
pages.text: Bogaty w rudy $(thing)piroksenitowy$() teren, poprzecinany rzekami lawy.

pages.title: Bazaltowe delty
pages.text: Twój ulubiony netherowy biom powraca i jest tak samo niebezpieczny do przechodzenia, jak zwykle.

pages.title: Geologia
pages.text: Like the overworld, the Beneath has its own set of rock layers. At the very top, you may find Phyllite, Schist, Gneiss, Marble, Slate, Migmatite, and Travertine.$(br2)Underneath those, you may find Schist, Gneiss, Tuff, Migmatite, Travertine, and Diorite.
Below that is either Gabbro, Granite, Tuff, Diorite, or Migmatite.$(br2)At the lower levels of the Beneath, there is a layer of exclusively Migmatite, followed by Pyroxenite at the very bottom.

pages.title: Więcej skał
pages.text: Some other stones can be found in other locations.$(br2)Small lava pools are surrounded by $(item)Pyroxenite$(), while $(item)Calcite$() can be found in spring water pools.$(br2)$(item)Keratophyre$() can be found all over the Beneath in large, tall columns.

The $(l:beneath/beneath#geothermal_springs)Geothermal Springs$() biome contains the exclusive $(item)Aragonite$() and $(item)Glauberite$(), along with more Calcite.$(br2)This biome also houses $(item)Huge Quartz$() crystals, which can either be broken with a pickaxe to obtain $(item)Smoky Quartz$() gems of varying quality, or broken with a $(item)Gem Saw$() to obtain the transparent block itself.

$(item)Gilsonite$(), a very dark building block and ingredient of $(l:logistics/roads#asphalt)Asphalt$(), can be found in large quantities in the $(l:beneath/beneath#tar_pools)Tar Pools$() biome, along with $(item)Sandstone$().$(br2)Finally, $(item)Halite$() can be found in massive quantities in the $(l:beneath/beneath#salt_caves)Salt Caves$() biome, which can be mined for Halite and Sylvite ores.
